text:
Alex: Heads-up — dedicated canary for the 2026-03-18 release is showing p95 jump to 820ms on model-x, baseline 260ms. This is blocking rollout, assigning triage. :warning:
Marta: seeing it too, spike coincides with merge 8f3a2b (kernel-optimizer refactor). Profile shows more fallback to 'slow_attention_v2' for seq>1024.
Ryan: my runs show batching hints are now favoring microbatching for long sequences which prevents continuous batching. Throughput down ~11%.
Jing: CI perf job failed on the merge too — pipeline/perf/throughput reported 10-15% regressions on dedicated GPUs. I can paste logs.
perf-bot: Canary alert: dedicated/model-x p95=820ms (threshold 600ms). Auto-pausing rollout.
Alex: can we bisect? who owns merge 8f3a2b?
Marta: I do the refactor. I will run a local bisect, but quick check: the kernel selection heuristic now scores kernel cost using flops_est but ignores kv-cache hit-rate, so long sequences fall back.
Ryan: reproduce locally with `scripts/run_bench --model model-x --seq 1536 --batch 8` shows 3x latency vs main.
Jing: attaching minimal reproducer log: `batch_hint: prefer_small_microbatches=true` — that's new.
Alex: let's revert the commit to unblock rollout, then do a slower follow-up. Any objections?
Marta: agree. I'll open a revert PR now, and also push a hotfix to re-enable kv-aware scoring.
Ryan: after revert we should run the dedicated canary again and the perf CI gate.
SRE-Oncall: FYI customers on dedicated-nyc might see higher p95 until we roll back. Contacting account execs.
Jing: created issue PERF-3912 and PR #4123 revert linked. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4123
Alex: nice. ETA for revert merge?
Marta: pushing now, should be green in ~10m if tests pass.
perf-bot: rollback request noted, canary remains paused. :thumbsup:
Ryan: post-merge run smoke bench and mark canary for manual re-run.
Alex: thanks all, let's keep thread updates brief. Ping me if anything blocks.
